# Easy Spaces Office Budget Calculator

> Free office furniture cost calculator for Phoenix and Las Vegas businesses by Easy Spaces. Compare buying outright, rent-to-own, subscription, and used furniture.

Key facts:
- Rent-to-own: from $349/mo, $0 upfront. Delivery & install quoted separately.
- Subscription: from $379/mo, $0 upfront. Delivery and install built into your monthly price. Shortest term 12 months. Longer terms lower the monthly price.
- Subscription: removal at lease end at no charge.
- Budget: $20 per sq ft max budget, most projects come in under that.
- Move-in ready in 7-28 days once your space is set.
- Free consultation and a 3D layout for every project.
- From-prices: chairs $299, desks $699, cubicles $1,500 to $3,000 per station, reception $1,999, conference $1,200, training $425.
- Tenant representation: We can connect you with a licensed broker in Arizona or Nevada for tenant representation.
- Easy Spaces Phoenix showroom: 1801 E Camelback Rd Suite 201, Phoenix, AZ 85016, (480) 382-1171.
- Easy Spaces Gilbert showroom: 2162 E Williams Field Rd Suite #111, Gilbert, AZ 85295, 602-361-5186.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Appointments recommended.
- President: Jason Bowman.
- Installed to date: 26,923+ chairs and 1,833+ desks.
